hyperedges.label: Rolling-number odometer flow in opex home
Data interface + pure rules enable UI rebuild and local-first checking
Overview load moment (rolling numbers + bar fill + tiles)
SAGE request lifecycle across requester, triage and DDAT
All write paths share pure plan functions
Every view is a shareable URL

nodes.label: DataSource Interface
nodes.rationale: Screens only see one interface; mock implements it in memory and a second file implements the real backend, so the backend only affects one file.

nodes.label: Plan Functions (pure rules)
nodes.rationale: Pure functions returning {ok:false,error} or {ok:true,patch,summary} make every rule testable; form, board drag and bulk actions all call the same function.

nodes.label: Power Apps Code Apps Hosting
nodes.rationale: Hosted in a frame: use HashRouter, wrap storage and clipboard, check fit-to-window under the host header bar; each user needs a Premium licence.

nodes.label: Wire Conversion (fromWire / toWire)
nodes.rationale: Keeps backend naming out of the app so a renamed column is a one-line change.

nodes.label: One-Page Form with Review Dialog
nodes.rationale: No wizard screens; all questions on one page in named sections; 'Review and submit' validates then shows 'Check your request' dialog.

nodes.label: Saving on Edit Screens (one save per decision area)
nodes.norm_label: saving on edit screens (one save per decision area)

nodes.label: Form Validation (errors after first attempt)
nodes.rationale: Completeness check is a pure function shared by form and tests; errors linked with aria-describedby.

nodes.label: Fit to Window
nodes.rationale: Page never scrolls on desktop; one .fill region scrolls inside itself so toolbars, tabs, pagers and submit bars stay in view.

nodes.label: Kanban Board
nodes.rationale: Drag and drop runs the same plan function as the edit form; never write a status change the form would not allow.

nodes.label: Stack (react-router v7, TanStack v8, cmdk, lucide, recharts, vitest)
nodes.norm_label: stack (react-router v7, tanstack v8, cmdk, lucide, recharts, vitest)
nodes.rationale: Hash routing survives the host frame; TanStack Table v9 has a different API so v8 is pinned; self-hosted font avoids CDN calls; one plain CSS file with custom properties instead of a framework.

nodes.label: Business App Patterns Skill
nodes.rationale: Patterns cover structure, navigation and layout only; visual identity (colours, typeface, voice) is chosen per project so SAGE branding is never shipped in another app.

nodes.label: Server-Side Role Query Restriction
nodes.rationale: A requester's list call filters to their own records so other people's data is never downloaded.

nodes.label: SharePoint Notes
nodes.rationale: Choice/lookup objects converted in wire file; statuses in their own list so a new status is a row not a code change; index filter columns; only additive changes are safe when a canvas app shares lists.

nodes.label: Full-Width Pages Beside the Rail
nodes.rationale: Limit text line length (68-72ch) instead of the page, so collapsing the rail leaves no dead space.

nodes.label: Before Building: Roles, Statuses, Data Location, Host
nodes.norm_label: before building: roles, statuses, data location, host
nodes.rationale: These four answers decide most of the app's structure; each role gets its own view of a record rather than one screen with hidden fields.

nodes.label: Order of Work
nodes.rationale: Types, then DataSource and mock, then logic with tests, then store/router/shell, then screens, fit-to-window last once content settles, real backend last.

nodes.label: Quality Bar
nodes.rationale: Keyboard-only use, standard states, both themes, no scroll at 1320x720 and 1700x900, reduced motion, action-named buttons, every role checked via persona.

nodes.label: Pin @tanstack/react-table v8
nodes.rationale: v9 does not export useReactTable; install v8.

nodes.label: Every UI Lock Has a Twin at the Write
nodes.norm_label: every ui lock has a twin at the write
nodes.rationale: If a button is hidden for a role, the plan function also refuses that role, so bypassing the UI cannot bypass the rule.

nodes.label: Roles Resolved to Booleans
nodes.rationale: Resolve once at start-up (canTriage, canEditDdat, canSeeDdatQueue, isSageAdmin) so components do not repeat membership logic.

nodes.label: App Store (single context provider)
nodes.rationale: Failures in secondary loads (group membership, conversations) degrade with a warning rather than stopping the app.

nodes.label: Choice Cards (pick one)
nodes.rationale: A real radio group (fieldset/legend, hidden radio in label) gives arrow keys and screen reader support without extra code.

nodes.label: Status Tones
nodes.rationale: Tone class sets --tone, --tone-bg, --tone-solid so a status looks the same everywhere; always show the name beside the colour.

nodes.label: Conversation Thread
nodes.rationale: Replaces email back-and-forth; closed means closed, enforced both in UI and in planComment.

nodes.label: Grid (DataTable)
nodes.rationale: Keep only columns that help pick a row; drop a column before letting the table scroll sideways.

nodes.label: Long Text Folding (Show all N words)
nodes.norm_label: long text folding (show all n words)

nodes.label: Overview Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Every number is a link to the list that explains it; numbers computed in src/logic/stats.ts not the component.

nodes.label: Record Page by Role (tabs per audience)
nodes.norm_label: record page by role (tabs per audience)
nodes.rationale: The ask comes first so a triager reads the request before decision fields; separate saves for separate decisions.

nodes.label: Filters in the URL
nodes.rationale: Write with replace:true so the Back button is not filled with filter changes.

nodes.label: Motion (formerly Framer Motion)
nodes.rationale: Add only when the user asks for page transitions, cross-column card animation or list reordering.

nodes.label: RollingNumber
nodes.rationale: Reel holds 0-9 twice (20 items, 5% each) so every digit spins a full turn; real value in aria-label, reels hidden.

nodes.label: Status Bar Fill (clip-path)
nodes.rationale: clip-path reveal keeps segment proportions true throughout.

nodes.label: Routes and Deep Links
nodes.rationale: Tabs, side sheets and filters are all in the URL so any view can be shared or bookmarked; deep links guarded by role inside the page.

nodes.label: Side Rail
nodes.rationale: Width is one CSS variable shared with the content margin so they never disagree; collapse is instant with no width transition to avoid reflow.

nodes.label: Motion Policy (load moment and action responses only)
nodes.norm_label: motion policy (load moment and action responses only)
nodes.rationale: Plain CSS plus one component, no animation library; no entrance animations on every card.

nodes.label: Motion Timing (2.2s load, 0.12-0.2s responses)
nodes.rationale: 0.9s was too fast to notice; 2.2s with bar and numbers on the same duration reads as one deliberate moment.

nodes.label: Native <dialog> for Dialogs and Side Sheets
nodes.norm_label: native <dialog> for dialogs and side sheets
nodes.rationale: Focus trapping, Escape and backdrop come from the browser for free.

nodes.label: render() live and coming-soon app cards
nodes.norm_label: render() live and coming-soon app cards

nodes.label: Overview motion: clip-path status bar and odometer numbers
nodes.norm_label: overview motion: clip-path status bar and odometer numbers
nodes.rationale: Hand-written CSS, no animation library; sub-second version was too fast to notice so it runs about 2.2s; disabled under reduced motion.

nodes.label: Long answers folded into reading blocks with 'Show all N words'
nodes.norm_label: long answers folded into reading blocks with 'show all n words'

nodes.label: Reset filters button shown only when filtering
nodes.norm_label: reset filters button shown only when filtering

nodes.label: Front Store or Rx question and Rx tag
nodes.norm_label: front store or rx question and rx tag

nodes.label: Collapsible side rail (one CSS width variable)
nodes.norm_label: collapsible side rail (one css width variable)
nodes.rationale: Width change is instant because animating width reflowed the whole page; page max width removed so content takes the freed space.

nodes.label: App search filter with gliding cards and '/' shortcut
nodes.norm_label: app search filter with gliding cards and '/' shortcut

nodes.label: Demo routes (hub, requests/:id/:tab, new, ddat/:id, register)
nodes.norm_label: demo routes (hub, requests/:id/:tab, new, ddat/:id, register)

nodes.label: Application register and AI Governance review
nodes.norm_label: application register and ai governance review

nodes.label: Help panel FAQ (request types, priorities, statuses)
nodes.norm_label: help panel faq (request types, priorities, statuses)

nodes.label: Power Apps code app (React, TypeScript, Vite)
nodes.norm_label: power apps code app (react, typescript, vite)

nodes.label: Requester-admin conversation thread (whose turn, closed on completion)
nodes.norm_label: requester-admin conversation thread (whose turn, closed on completion)
nodes.rationale: Removes manual email outside SAGE; reply-needed derived from last author; closed-check also in the write function so it holds if UI is bypassed.

nodes.label: Domain admin insights tiles and 'waiting longest' list
nodes.norm_label: domain admin insights tiles and 'waiting longest' list

nodes.label: Fit to window: one inline scroll region per page
nodes.norm_label: fit to window: one inline scroll region per page

nodes.label: What is not done (email notifications, DDAT posting, bundle split)
nodes.norm_label: what is not done (email notifications, ddat posting, bundle split)

nodes.label: Redesign away from canvas look (routes, grid, palette, chart, themes)
nodes.norm_label: redesign away from canvas look (routes, grid, palette, chart, themes)

nodes.label: Request page tabs per role (Requester, Triage, DDAT hand-off, Activity)
nodes.norm_label: request page tabs per role (requester, triage, ddat hand-off, activity)
nodes.rationale: Triage and hand-off save separately through their own rule functions so one cannot overwrite the other; triage reading order is ask, decision, conversation, kept via CSS order.

nodes.label: How the SAGE request-intake app was built
nodes.norm_label: how the sage request-intake app was built

nodes.label: Card grows into app page (shared view-transition-name)
nodes.norm_label: card grows into app page (shared view-transition-name)

nodes.label: Local-first, small-steps workflow; push to dev only on request
nodes.norm_label: local-first, small-steps workflow; push to dev only on request

nodes.label: One data interface (DataSource: in-memory and SharePoint)
nodes.norm_label: one data interface (datasource: in-memory and sharepoint)
nodes.rationale: Screens never call a connector directly, so the whole UI could be rebuilt without touching data, and every change could be checked locally on sample data before real data.

nodes.label: Rules as pure functions (src/logic, unit tested)
nodes.norm_label: rules as pure functions (src/logic, unit tested)
nodes.rationale: Edit permissions, save payloads and required fields live outside React with 32 unit tests; a rule change comes with a test change, and checks hold even if the UI is bypassed.

nodes.label: Pin @tanstack/react-table to v8
nodes.rationale: v9 has a different API from the widely documented one.

nodes.label: One-page form with review dialog and local draft
nodes.norm_label: one-page form with review dialog and local draft

nodes.label: Choice cards backed by a real radio group
nodes.norm_label: choice cards backed by a real radio group
